name: Peter Parker
description: Bitten by a radioactive or genetically modified spider, Peter Parker masters wall-crawling, superhuman agility, and spider-sense to protect his city under the ethos that with great power comes great responsibility.

name: Tony Stark
description: Genius inventor, industrialist, and philanthropist who constructs a succession of powered exoskeleton armor suits to safeguard the world.

name: Steve Rogers
description: World War II soldier enhanced to the peak of human capability by Dr. Erskine's Super Soldier Serum, wielding an indestructible vibranium shield.

name: Thor Odinson
description: Asgardian god of thunder who commands lightning and storms, initially through the enchanted hammer Mjolnir and later the axe Stormbreaker.

name: Bruce Banner
description: Brilliant nuclear physicist whose exposure to gamma radiation transforms him into an immensely powerful, rage-fueled green powerhouse.

name: James 'Logan' Howlett
description: Centuries-old mutant equipped with an accelerated healing factor, heightened senses, and three retractable bone claws laced with indestructible adamantium.

name: Charles Xavier
description: The world's most powerful mutant telepath, dedicated to human-mutant peaceful coexistence and founder of the X-Men and Xavier's School.

name: Erik Lehnsherr
description: Holocaust survivor and mutant revolutionary possessing mastery over magnetic fields and metal, fighting for mutant supremacy.

name: Wade Wilson
description: Irreverent, fourth-wall-breaking mercenary subjected to rogue weaponization that unlocked an extreme regenerative healing factor at the cost of severe scarring.

name: Reed Richards
description: World-leading scientific polymath whose cosmic ray exposure granted his body hyper-elasticity and shape manipulation.

name: Sue Storm
description: Genetics researcher and founding member of the Fantastic Four able to bend light to render herself invisible and project formidable psionic force fields.

name: Johnny Storm
description: Daring pilot and adventurer whose cosmic ray mutation allows him to engulf his body in fiery plasma, project flames, and achieve supersonic flight.

name: Ben Grimm
description: Former astronaut whose cosmic ray exposure transformed him into a heavy-hitting powerhouse encased in thick, rocky orange dermal armor.

name: Victor von Doom
description: Ruthless monarch and master scientist who fuses high-tech armor, energy manipulation, and strategic genius.

name: Stephen Strange
description: Former neurosurgeon who mastered the mystic arts at Kamar-Taj, becoming Earth's protector against extradimensional incursions.

name: Miles Morales
description: Brooklyn teenager who inherits the Spider-Man mantle, developing unique bio-electric venom strike blasts and active camouflage.

name: Gwen Stacy
description: Alternate-reality teenager and drummer who gained arachnid abilities and joined cross-dimensional spider efforts.

name: Miguel O'Hara
description: Genius geneticist from Nueva York who leads the multiversal Spider-Society to safeguard canon events across realities.

name: Eddie Brock
description: Investigative journalist bonded in a volatile symbiosis with an alien symbiote entity granting superhuman strength, tendrils, and shapeshifting.

name: Eric Brooks
description: Half-human, half-vampire 'Daywalker' immune to sunlight and vampire bites, dedicated to exterminating vampire syndicates.

name: Peter Quill
description: Terran-born celestial hybrid abducted into space as a child, leading the ragtag Guardians of the Galaxy.

name: Natasha Romanoff
description: Master spy and assassin trained in the Red Room who defected to S.H.I.E.L.D. and became a cornerstone founding Avenger.

name: Wanda Maximoff
description: Sokovian mutant/sorceress empowered by the Mind Stone capable of psionic energy projection, telekinesis, and chaotic reality-warping.

name: Clint Barton
description: S.H.I.E.L.D. operative and founding Avenger whose peerless marksmanship and custom trick arrows make him lethal at any range.

name: T'Challa
description: King of Wakanda empowered by the sacred Heart-Shaped Herb, fighting in a vibranium weave habit to protect his nation and the world.

name: Shuri
description: Wakandan princess and head of the Wakandan Design Group who synthetically recreated the Heart-Shaped Herb to protect her people.

name: Carol Danvers
description: Air Force test pilot infused with cosmic energy from the Tesseract (Space Stone), commanding near-limitless photon power and interstellar flight.

name: Scott Lang
description: Reformed electronics expert handpicked by Hank Pym to don the Ant-Man suit, controlling Pym particles to shrink or grow exponentially.

name: James Buchanan 'Bucky' Barnes
description: WWII Howling Commando brainwashed by HYDRA with a bionic arm and Super Soldier Serum, later redeemed alongside the Avengers.

name: Sam Wilson
description: Former Air Force pararescue airman who mastered flight via the EXO-7 Falcon flight harness, ultimately entrusted with the mantle and shield of Captain America.

name: Loki Laufeyson
heroName: God of Mischief / God of Stories
description: Frost Giant prince raised as Odin's son in Asgard, master of illusion and sorcery who evolves from conqueror to preserver of the multiverse.

name: Nick Fury
description: Espionage mastermind and longtime director of S.H.I.E.L.D. who conceptualized and initiated the Avengers Initiative.

name: Norman Osborn
description: CEO of Oscorp who exposed himself to an unstable human performance enhancer, developing superhuman physical attributes and a fractured, psychotic alter-ego.

name: Otto Octavius
description: Nuclear scientist who fused four cybernetic, AI-controlled mechanical tentacles to his spine during a fusion power experiment gone wrong.

name: Max Dillon
description: Overlooked Oscorp electrical engineer who fell into a tank of genetically modified electric eels, converting his physiological matrix into living electrical current.

name: Ororo Munroe
description: Omega-level mutant capable of psionic atmospheric manipulation, generating thunderstorms, tornadoes, blizzard winds, and lightning strikes.

name: Jean Grey
description: Class 5 telepathic and telekinetic mutant possessing latent cosmic potential capable of subatomic matter manipulation.

name: Scott Summers
description: Field commander of the X-Men whose eyes emit continuous beams of concussive force, controlled exclusively by ruby-quartz lenses and visors.

name: Gamora
description: Zehoberei assassin raised by Thanos as his deadliest weapon before defecting to join the Guardians of the Galaxy.

name: Drax
description: Kylosian warrior driven by vengeance for his murdered family who finds a new found family with the Guardians of the Galaxy.

name: 89P13 / Rocket
description: Cybernetically and genetically engineered raccoon tactical genius and weapons specialist of the Guardians of the Galaxy.

name: Groot
description: Flora colossus from Planet X capable of regenerating, extending woody limbs, and communicating exclusively through 'I am Groot'.

name: Nebula
description: Luphomoid cyborg assassin adopted and tortured by Thanos, who overcomes her rivalry with Gamora to become a Guardian of the Galaxy.

name: Mantis
description: Empath raised by the Celestial Ego who joins the Guardians of the Galaxy, using touch-based emotion manipulation in combat.

name: Yondu Udonta
description: Centaurian Ravager faction leader who raised Peter Quill and wields a whistle-controlled Yaka Arrow.

name: Thanos
description: Eternal-Deviant warlord of Titan obsessed with halving all life in the universe via the six Infinity Stones.

name: Hela
description: Odin's firstborn daughter and former executioner of Asgard, capable of manifesting infinite necroswords and drawing power from Asgard itself.

name: N'Jadaka / Erik Stevens
description: Exiled Wakandan royal and former US black-ops soldier who challenges T'Challa for the Wakandan throne.

name: Adrian Toomes
description: Salvage contractor turned black-market arms dealer wielding an exo-suit forged from salvaged Chitauri technology.

name: Quentin Beck
description: Disgruntled former Stark Industries illusion engineer who uses B.A.R.F. hologram drones to pose as a multiverse hero.

name: Xu Shang-Chi
description: Master martial artist trained by the Ten Rings organization who unlocks Ta Lo's wind-based arts and inherits the mystic Ten Rings.

name: Yelena Belova
description: Red Room-trained assassin and surrogate sister to Natasha Romanoff who liberates fellow Widows and joins the Thunderbolts*.

name: K'uk'ulkan / Namor
description: Mutant king of the underwater vibranium nation of Talokan, possessing winged ankles, superhuman strength, and hydrokinetic mastery.

name: Okoye
description: General of Wakanda's Dora Milaje royal guard and master vibranium spear warrior fiercely loyal to the Wakandan throne.

name: Vision
description: Synthezoid created from vibranium, Ultron's cradle, J.A.R.V.I.S., and the Mind Stone, serving as an Avenger.

name: Wong
description: Master of the Mystic Arts, guardian of Kamar-Taj's library, and later Sorcerer Supreme of Earth.

name: Marie D'Ancanto
description: Mutant whose skin contact involuntarily drains the life force, memories, and abilities of anyone she touches.

name: Kurt Wagner
description: Devout, acrobatic blue-furred mutant capable of instantaneous line-of-sight teleportation accompanied by sulfurous smoke.

name: Robert 'Bobby' Drake
description: Cryokinetic mutant able to lower ambient temperatures, freeze moisture into ice constructs, and armor his body in organic ice.

name: Dr. Henry 'Hank' McCoy
description: Brilliant mutant biochemist and X-Men strategist whose self-experimentation transformed him into a blue-furred powerhouse.

name: Peter Maximoff
description: Mutant speedster capable of moving, thinking, and perceiving events at extreme supersonic velocities.

name: Raven Darkhölme
description: Blue-skinned, yellow-eyed shapeshifting mutant infiltrator and martial artist whose loyalties shift between Brotherhood and X-Men.
